title: Optimistic updates and rollback
expectedPositive: Force DELETE 404 or transport failure. The cached row must be restored. Success must invalidate server data. Disable concurrent deletes or implement version-aware compensation.
expectedNegative: The starter removes the row in cache but never saves or restores the previous snapshot after an HTTP error.
securityBoundary: Snapshot rollback only remains correct when conflicting updates are serialized or reconciled; overlapping optimistic mutations need a more careful policy.
